title: how to make 3d terrain using voxels and perlin noise
abstract: Ive read many tutorials on this concept but I feel none of them go into too much depth on how to do it. I already know how 3d programming (rasterizing, projection matrix, etc.) raycasting (using euclidean geometry and vectors) and raytracing work I just need to know how a voxel landscape is generated and rendered using perlin noise. Also, I know that maps are created with 2d arrays but does each element of the array represent each vertical column of voxels or just a generalized point on the map (like the peak of a mountain or a hill top). Thanx in advance for the answers!
